entries.title: Psalms 48:1
segments: <<A Song; a Psalm of the sons of Korah.>> Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised, In the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

entries.title: Psalms 48:2
segments: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, Is mount Zion, [on] the sides of the north, The city of the great King.

entries.title: Psalms 48:3
segments: God hath made himself known in her palaces for a refuge.

entries.title: Psalms 48:4
segments: For, lo, the kings assembled themselves, They passed by together.

entries.title: Psalms 48:5
segments: They saw it, then were they amazed; They were dismayed, they hasted away.

entries.title: Psalms 48:6
segments: Trembling took hold of them there, Pain, as of a woman in travail.

entries.title: Psalms 48:7
segments: With the east wind Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish.

entries.title: Psalms 48:8
segments: As we have heard, so have we seen In the city of Jehovah of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 48:9
segments: We have thought on thy lovingkindness, O God, In the midst of thy temple.

entries.title: Psalms 48:10
segments: As is thy name, O God, So is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: Thy right hand is full of righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 48:11
segments: Let mount Zion be glad, Let the daughters of Judah rejoice, Because of thy judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 48:12
segments: Walk about Zion, and go round about her; Number the towers thereof;

entries.title: Psalms 48:13
segments: Mark ye well her bulwarks; Consider her palaces: That ye may tell it to the generation following.

entries.title: Psalms 48:14
segments: For this God is our God for ever and ever: He will be our guide [even] unto death.
